item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I liked it, but I'm afraid I'm downvoting, simply because it didn't seem professional enough. I understand you wouldn't want to waste the time of some high-profile staff member on D-Class orientations, but Doc-I SAID SHUT THE HELL UP! seems a little too clueless. He could be doing it on purpose, but the humorous "oops I almost let slip we execute the class Ds" doesn't feel quite right.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Agreed. Yes, the logs all show a number of D-Class getting eaten up by the Keters and occasionally Euclids, but most of those either stop testing or figure out how to keep from getting killed after a few instances. Not all of the objects are being tested constantly (only so many researchers per site), so 3000 is more than enough to go around in the US branches.

As for "why are there so many that speak English", I'd say they're being translated for convenience. There is also the clause that lesser criminals can be used in case of a shortage of death row inmates.

I don't think the death rate would be that high except from the terminations. Most SCPs don't actually burn through that many D-Class that quickly. Then again, that just goes for the SCPs we actually know about.

The D-Class get no love, so I thought this would be kinda cool.

I ended up writing it how I would act if I were a bottom of the food chain Researcher Junior Researcher Junior Assistant Researcher Junior Assistant to the Researcher who had to yell at a bunch of deathrow inmates.
